field_meaning.hi: रीइन्फोर्समेंट लर्निंग में मान फलन का अंतर।

review_objections: Google: The Hindi definition is slightly inaccurate; it refers to the difference between successive estimates of a value function, not just the difference of the value function itself.
Alibaba: Topic is incorrect; Temporal Difference is a core concept in Reinforcement Learning, not Robotics.
